items.name: AmberX AXF
items.notes: The claude.ai Project for this repo.
items.recreate: Create a Project with the same name and description; instructions = INSTRUCTIONS.md, knowledge = every file in context/.

items.name: AXF Pending Builds
items.notes: Artifact page with db collection `builds`; mirrors framework/plan/pending.json field for field.
items.recreate: Ask Claude to publish a Pending Builds page from framework/plan/pending.json (fields: id, title, detail, model, status, notes, subPrompts, estimate, dates in epoch ms), then put its new link in project.manifest.json → links.pendingBuilds.

items.name: Kernel checklist
items.notes: Checklist artifact for the kernel build.
items.recreate: Rebuild from framework/plan/build-queue.json and framework/catalog/status.json; update links.kernelChecklist.

items.name: axHub
items.notes: Connector hub (list_services, describe_service, call, axhub.memory_*). Approvals at https://axhub.amberxai.com/auth/admin/approvals.
items.recreate: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector → the URL; sign in with the hub (token AXHUB_MCP_TOKEN, never pasted in chat).

items.name: AXF Dev Console MCP
items.recreate: Add as a custom connector, or reach it through axHub (it is axHub's first downstream service).

items.name: GitHub (account MossesX)
items.recreate: Connect GitHub as MossesX and give the Claude GitHub app access to the repos.

items.name: Hostinger
items.notes: DNS for amberxai.com (rule: DNS is done by the session, logged in /projects/_shared/_data/dns/log.md).
items.recreate: Add the Hostinger connector; token from hPanel → Account → API.

items.name: claude.ai memory
items.notes: Paste the account's memory (Settings → Capabilities → Memory) in the console so it travels with the kit.
items.recreate: Import with the memory import (claude.ai → Settings → Memory) from user/claude-ai/memory.md.
